title: 【4K】 Walking around Busan Station, Korea  부산역
description:
Today we walk around Busan Railway Station.  Starting from the square of Busan Station, we walk into the building of Busan Station and look around the status of the station.  Busan Station is a starting point and last stop in South Korea along with Seoul Station.  So it is pretty meaningful.  In addition, the station is in front of Busan Port.  It means it is located in the end of the Korean Peninsula.

Started to film at 12:30 PM on Feb. 25 , 2021
Temperature : 12℃  ☁
